set.title: Initialize WikiTicket SDD and capture the v0.4.0 release plan
Build a complete deterministic AGER scaffold generator
Add tests, CI, and strict sample validation
Add native Codex packaging and v0.4.0 documentation

set.resolution: Initialized WikiTicket SDD v0.22.0, configured GitHub Issues and GitHub Wiki, installed repository policy, captured the approved plan, and rendered the roadmap.
Added a complete canonical scaffold and an atomic generator that refuses overwrites, renders title/timestamps, and requires strict AGER validation before installation.
Added a dependency-free AGER validator with JSON output, strict warning semantics, reference checks, control checks, output-mode checks, tool safety checks, secret checks, and schema validation.
Added 14 regression and packaging tests, strict AGER and OKF sample gates, a pinned okf-plugin v0.3.2 CI checkout, and eliminated prompt warnings plus duplicated template sources.
Added a validated native Codex manifest, documented Codex installation and skill invocation, added a changelog, and moved all plugin manifests to v0.4.0 while retaining AGER schema v0.3.0.
Implemented v0.4.0 quality foundation: canonical scaffold, deterministic generator, standard-library validator, strict tests and CI, Codex packaging, and release documentation.

set.body: Stamp the v0.4.0 changelog, capture the release snapshot, land and tag the release, create the GitHub release, publish the generated wiki pages, and reconcile the publication ledger.

set.resolution: Generated repository-grounded current architecture and code walkthrough documents, validated all Mermaid diagrams, stamped them against v0.4.0, froze the dated release pair, and published all four wiki pages.
Added task-oriented User Guide, CLI Reference, and Plugin Guide pages, corrected Codex dependency guidance, linked them from README, and published them to the GitHub wiki.
Published the AGER specification as a first-class wiki page and replaced generic worklog navigation with AGER-specific guide and specification links.
Updated the packaging invariant to accept either an unreleased or ISO-dated v0.4.0 changelog heading; all 14 tests pass after stamping.
Added workflow_dispatch to quality and worklog workflows and used it to validate the exact release PR head when GitHub omitted push and PR runs.
Ignored .work/wiki-checkout so the git-backed wiki cache cannot enter main-repository commits.
Landed PR #1, tagged and released v0.4.0, generated current and frozen release documentation, and published the complete GitHub wiki manifest with a revision-backed ledger.
